events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Monty Python Legend
angles.copy: From Fawlty Towers to Monty Python, John Cleese has given us some of the most memorable comedy moments. Happy 87th to a true British legend!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as the 'White Album', was released in the UK on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Revolutionary Sound
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling, experimental masterpiece that was the 'White Album'. What's your go-to track from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: A Champion's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years today, we lost a true rock icon. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. His legacy continues to rock us.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Folk Rock Fusion
angles.copy: Released 61 years ago today, 'Rubber Soul' saw The Beatles push musical boundaries, blending folk and rock in innovative ways. A timeless album.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of The Beatles legend John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate around the world. A true visionary.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary musician and cultural icon, David Bowie, born in 1947.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible life and artistry of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. Forever a Starman, forever changing music.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're still all shook up for Elvis Presley. The King's music lives on!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The riffs, the solos, the legacy – a true guitar god.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Still rockin' after all these years! Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. What's your favourite raspy-voiced hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: It Must Be Love
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the voice of Madness! From Camden Town to global stages, he's given us decades of ska-pop joy.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Soulful Voice
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the incredible Paul Young! His soulful voice defined an era and still sounds fantastic today.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: From humble beginnings to global superstar, happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! What's your favourite Dolly classic?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo hits, he's a true pop maestro. What's your favourite Gary-penned tune?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British R&B and soul singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Soul
angles.copy: Get out your dancing shoes! Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean, whose hits still make us 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car'.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1986, the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Honouring Legends
angles.copy: Rewind to 1986: the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction ceremony, cementing the legacies of music's greatest. Who was your favourite original inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, he's still got that magic touch.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: London's Last Gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles made history with their impromptu rooftop concert in London. An unforgettable moment in music.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning musician Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a hugely successful solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A drumming powerhouse and a vocal icon. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: From *NSYNC to solo superstardom, happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! What's your favourite JT hit?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Peckham to Poplar, he's brought joy to millions.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years on, we remember Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on, a powerful legacy from 'The Day The Music Died'.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s hits and viral comeback, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! From chart-topper to internet sensation, he's truly never gonna give us up.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Today would have been the 82nd birthday of reggae icon Bob Marley, born in 1945.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley. His message of 'One Love' resonates more than ever.
